notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Sigil of the Nayan Gods attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and has a power of one or greater.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
